summary.text:
The visible text begins partway through a numbered list. Its top line is "7: red green blue", and the lines after it read "entry 980: red green blue", "entry 981: red green blue" and so on.

So which counts as the first entry? What is wanted is the label on the earliest visible line.

Two readings:
- the top line, numbered 7;
- the first line labelled "entry", numbered 980.

The top line is what appears first, so the answer is 7.
